newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy minister sees industrial recovery in May.
newsitem.headline: Italy minister sees industrial recovery in May.

text.p: Industry Minister Pier Luigi Bersani said on Friday that he expected a rise in industrial output in April to be extended in May.

"The (preliminary inflation data) for this month seems especially significant to me because it follows the first signs of recovery in industrial output that were seen in April and which are expected also for May," Bersani said in a statement.
He was speaking after preliminary consumer price index (CPI) data from five cities pointed to year-on-year June inflation of 1.5 percent after 1.6 percent in May.
April industrial output rose an unadjusted 8.2 percent year-on-year in April.
